decisions.reason: Strong early adoption and close fit with existing data integration capabilities give high absorptive capacity to improve it.
Although it builds on the established offer, the lack of reported early results limits the firm's ability to interpret its value, so there is moderate risk but related knowledge supports keeping it.
Cyber security awareness training is close to the firm's core training resources, making it easy to assimilate and improve despite only a website mention.
Behaviour analysis builds on specialist detection knowledge, so the firm can likely interpret its early performance and improve it.
Passenger security profiling method has only a website mention and may face regulatory and reputational challenges that weaken the firm's ability to apply it commercially.
Travel and document verification platform is close to the existing offer and has a dedicated webpage, suggesting manageable early results and related knowledge.
